provenance.title: Toy model with every kind of evidence

contexts.title: Describe the decay
contexts.question: Does the model describe the intravenous decay of A?

factors.name: Software quality assurance
factors.statement: pkpdsim and sbmlsim are released packages with tests and continuous integration; the model is released reproducibly from its repository with the versions and the commit of the provenance. Rebuild of 1 case: passed.

factors.name: Numerical code verification
factors.statement: sbmlsim runs the SBML Test Suite and the PEtab test suite.

factors.name: Discretization error
factors.statement: Largest relative difference 2.5e-06 of 10 decisive predictions with the tolerances of the fits divided by 100, at CredA.fm_train at 6, acceptance unchanged: passed.

factors.name: Numerical solver error
factors.statement: Largest relative difference 2.8e-06 of 10 decisive predictions with the BDF of CVODE of at most order 2 at the tightened tolerances, at CredA.fm_train at 8, acceptance unchanged: passed.

factors.name: Use error
factors.statement: The builds are valid SBML with consistent units and the 10 decisive predictions are finite: passed. Plausibility of the values of 4 cases: passed.

factors.name: Model form
factors.statement: The structure of the model across studies and drugs: the ratios, the cross-validation and the qualification across models.

factors.name: Model inputs
factors.statement: The uncertainty and the sensitivity of the parameters.

factors.name: Test samples
factors.statement: 10 points of 2 mappings of 2 studies of the calibration evidence decide, 10 of them evaluable (minimum 5).

factors.name: Test conditions
factors.statement: 0 claimed values of the metadata, 0 values of the evidence outside the claim.

factors.name: Equivalency of input parameters
factors.statement: Whether the inputs of the simulations of the evidence are the ones of the context of use: the individuals and their variability.

factors.name: Output comparison
factors.statement: 1 of 1 acceptance rule met on the calibration evidence, 0 not evaluable.

factors.name: Relevance of the quantities of interest
factors.statement: Whether the quantities of the evidence answer the question, e.g. the ratios of a special population. A context with a ratio quantity and its pairing assesses it by the pairs of its arms; else only that every claimed quantity which is no ratio has decisive points in the claimed domain is checked, see the relevance of the validation activities.

factors.statement: 0 of 0 claimed values and 1 of 1 quantity of interest covered.
